title: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
abstract: arXiv:2610.21791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex tasks, including code generation, tool use, and multi-hop question answering. Existing self-improvement methods enhance agent performance through model optimization, harness evolution, and executable artifact refinement, while recursive self-improvement (RSI) further extends optimization to the improvement mechanisms themselves. However, adapting self-improvement workflows to evolving performance bottlenecks while improving workflow orchestration through execution feedback remains a key challenge. We propose \textbf{RSIFlow}, a \textbf{R}ecursive \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{I}mprovement framework that integrates adaptive work\textbf{flow} orchestration with meta-agent capability evolution. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.21791v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体在复杂任务中已展现出强大的能力，包括代码生成、工具使用和多跳问答。现有的自我改进方法通过模型优化、测试框架演化和可执行工件精炼来提升智能体性能，而递归自我改进（RSI）进一步将优化范围扩展到改进机制本身。然而，如何让自我改进工作流适应不断演变的性能瓶颈，同时利用执行反馈来改进工作流编排，仍然是一个关键挑战。我们提出了 RSIFlow，这是一个递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement）框架，它将自适应工作流编排与元智能体能力演化相结合。RSIFlow 从任务-智能体轨迹和环境反馈中诊断性能瓶颈，从而动态选择针对特定组件的改进工作流。该元智能体……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RSIFlow 提出了一个递归自我改进框架，通过从任务轨迹和环境反馈中诊断性能瓶颈来动态选择针对特定组件的改进工作流，并将自适应工作流编排与元智能体能力的持续演化相结合。
en_tdlr: RSIFlow is a recursive self-improvement framework that diagnoses performance bottlenecks from task-agent trajectories and environmental feedback to dynamically select component-specific improvement workflows, integrating adaptive workflow orchestration with the evolving capabilities of a meta-agent.
